headers.//: Strict policy for the hub. The negative lookahead keeps it off the cabinet paths so the two CSPs never both apply — when a browser receives two CSP headers it enforces the intersection, which would strip the cabinets' 'unsafe-inline' and leave every game a blank canvas.

headers.value: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: https://er8gjyi4uh0ydwfr.public.blob.vercel-storage.com; media-src 'self' https://er8gjyi4uh0ydwfr.public.blob.vercel-storage.com; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; manifest-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests
camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=(), interest-cohort=()

headers.//: The cabinets. Each game is one self-contained file with one inline <script>, one <style> and inline style attributes, so 'unsafe-inline' is unavoidable without rewriting all three games. Still no third-party origin is permitted, so the zero-trust rule holds: nothing on these pages can phone anywhere out.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' data: blob:; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests
